b: Neon has released the official trailer for Artificial, Luca Guadagnino’s drama about the founding of OpenAI and the two-decade artificial intelligence arms race that led to it. Andrew Garfield gets top billing as Sam Altman, but the film’s protagonist is Ilya Sutskever (Yura Borisov), the computer scientist whose breakthrough with his mentor, AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton (Mark Rylance), sends Silicon Valley’s biggest players scrambling to become part of their vision. Years later, a chance meeting with Altman leads Ilya and a group of idealistic entrepreneurs to launch OpenAI, and as the company grows more powerful and valuable than anyone imagined, Ilya has to decide who he can trust with the technology.

Monica Barbaro plays OpenAI engineer Mira Murati, and Ike Barinholtz is Elon Musk, whose money helps get the company off the ground. Cooper Hoffman and Jason Schwartzman round out the cast, and Simon Rich wrote the script.

Reviewing the film out of the New York Film Festival, Slant’s Eli Friedberg found that Artificial “sputters on the fumes” of David Fincher’s The Social Network, but that, at its best, it’s “an eerily funny tale of the seductions of what amounts to a queer vampire, whose monstrous creation could doom the whole race of mortals.”
Artificial opens in select theaters on Christmas Day before expanding everywhere on January 8.
